newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato says cabinet approves stability plan.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato says cabinet approves stability plan.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday the Spanish cabinet had approved the nation's three-year stability plan.
"The cabinet approved the convergence plan," Rato told the media following the cabinet meeting.
The plan forecasts the public deficit and debt will fall sharply by 2000, while growth will run at an average of 3.2 percent from now through the year 2000.
